decision:
v1.4 (2026-08-13). THREE changes, only the first is a model change I am endorsing.

(1) SHAPE_SLOPE REGIME SPLIT. 1.30 was measured on 9 MAJORS on 2026-07-30 and installed as a GLOBAL constant over the ~141 non-major events the board prices. Refit the SAME estimand it was chosen by (LL-optimal stretch THROUGH _recal_shape, not a calibration slope) on 166 walk-forward events with 2026 held out. Non-majors -> per-market SHAPE_SLOPE_STD (top-N 1.00-1.03, win 1.21). On the 49-event untouched 2026 holdout the fitted values beat 1.30 on 8/8 markets, effect -0.00093 nats/row vs a PRE-REGISTERED -0.00088. MAJORS DELIBERATELY UNCHANGED at 1.30: their fitted slopes LOSE to 1.30 on 5 of 8 holdout majors, i.e. they are noise from 25 training events, and shipping them would repeat the very error being corrected. Majors path proven byte-identical (max |old-new| = 0.0).

(2) CUT_N. simulate() cut at min(69,k-1), a top-70 proxy and the PRE-2024 tour rule, wrong in every season in the warehouse. Now per-event via cut_rule(): 65 default / 50 Masters+signature / 70 PGA Champ+The Open / None for no-cut events. Rule agreement 62.7% -> 97.6% over 287 events with ZERO errors in the dangerous direction. make-cut calibration slope 0.570 -> 1.060; predicted-vs-actual 56.0/51.7 -> 51.83/51.74. NO_CUT_MAX_FIELD=100 is a guard scoped to one ambiguous event name, not a general rule.

(3) 14 PRE-EXISTING DRIFTS, NOT MINE, RECORDED NOT LAUNDERED. Before this re-stamp the manifest already reported 16 moved values; 14 predate today (TN_EDGE 0.04->0.02, and SHAPE_SLOPE/PRICE_FLOOR/BLEND_W/EV_MIN/VIG_*/B_RATIO_MAX/M_RATIO_MAX/TN_RATIO_* added post-freeze and never re-stamped). They are enumerated in superseded.values_moved. This re-stamp does NOT endorse them; it stops them hiding behind a stale manifest.

CONSEQUENCE, PRE-REGISTERED AS ACCEPTABLE: at s~1.00 the top-N EV screen keeps ~3 of 17 flags. Fewer bets is the intended effect. Do NOT respond by lowering EV_MIN or TN_EDGE.

The counted out-of-sample record restarts here for anything priced through simulate(). The birdie stream (pga_birdies.py, PRE-TEE 23-13 +8.98u) is untouched by all three changes.
